0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 36:1 , The grievous estate of the wicked
Psa 36:8 , The excellency of God's mercy
Psa 36:10 , David prays for favour to God's children.
This Psalm is supposed by some to have been composed by David at the beginning of Saul's persecutions
but Calmet and others, on good grounds, are of opinion that it was written during the Babylonian captivity.
